title: An etale sieve covering on the closed side covers after adjoining the open side
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion] and $i:Z\to X$ a morphism such that $i(Z)=X\setminus j(U)$. Use the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and base-change functor $b:X_{\mathrm{Et}}\to Z_{\mathrm{Et}}$. For $W\in X_{\mathrm{Et}}$, let $R_j(W)$ be the sieve whose arrows $V\to W$ have the image of $V\to X$ contained in $j(U)$. If $S$ is a sieve on $W$ whose image sieve $b_!S$ covers $b(W)$ on $Z_{\mathrm{Et}}$, then $S\cup R_j(W)$ covers $W$ on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$. No closed-immersion hypothesis on $i$ is needed.

source.place: Proposition proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward, converse essential-image calculation in site form. Existing proof: lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/OpenClosed/Supported.lean, Etale.sup_sieveOfRangeSubset_mem, with sieve Etale.sieveOfRangeSubset.

proof.text: Test joint surjectivity on a point $w$ of $W$. If its image in $X$ belongs to $j(U)$, the open $W\times_XU$ contains $w$ and its inclusion into $W$ belongs to $R_j(W)$.

Otherwise the complement equality gives a point $z$ of $Z$ with image equal to that of $w$. Surjectivity of the map from the underlying pullback to the topological fibre product gives a point $t$ of $W\times_XZ$ over $w,z$. Since $b_!S$ covers, $t$ lifts along an arrow in this image sieve. Such an arrow factors as an arbitrary arrow into $b(V)$ followed by $b(f)$ for some $f:V\to W$ belonging to $S$. Project the lifting point of $b(V)$ to $V$. The pullback projection equation shows that it maps to $w$ by $f$. Hence $S\cup R_j(W)$ covers every point. This is precisely Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback followed by the pointwise covering criterion in the existing Lean proof. For empty $W$ the pointwise assertion is vacuous.
